request_verbatim:
Давай тогда переделаем игру: покажи понятную схему работы, дай мне цель и возможность самому выбрать решение, а потом увидеть последствия.
так же после прохождения игры давай короткое предложение "чему должна была научить сцена...", "как этот этап связан с курсом" 
Я же правильно понимаю что мы изучаем слайды лекций через игру и это напрямую связано с моим курсом и поможет мне на экзамене?
decision: Games become the practice-first teaching format, mapped to retained BUS230 lectures and workshops. Two brief debrief sentences follow every completed scene. Preserve the curriculum; game completion is not mastery.

mission.title: Your café. Your workflow.
mission.objective: Prepare four orders with a clear route and responsibility for each, using one cashier and one cook.
mission.before: Counter orders reach the kitchen queue. App orders reach a separate screen with no assigned handoff. Staff know how to read the screens.
decisions: own arrangement requiring explicit modelling in discussion
mission.secondary_decision: FIFO, counter-first, or app-first preparation among available kitchen orders
mission.consequences: Deterministic movement of C001/A001/C002/A002 under stated model rules. Steps are model actions, not measured minutes. No invented revenue, satisfaction or real-world delay figures.
boundaries: Shared integration is assumed feasible for the next shift and must be tested in reality.
Added cashier workload is counted as handoffs but its effect on counter/pickup delays is not timed.
Cook can prepare one drink OR transfer one app ticket per step.
No new arrivals; same drink preparation cost.
Own plans have no invented automatic result; clarify and model them in chat.
